name: Craftsman's Writ: Pilferer's Gloves
summary: A transferable writ requests Pilferer's Gloves and gives the details for delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the transaction.

sections.title: A Written Order
sections.body: A faded note requests one pair of Pilferer's Gloves. It includes where to deliver them and how payment is arranged, and the writ can pass from hand to hand.

sections.title: The Transaction
sections.body: You need the writ with you when you bring the requested gloves to the marked location. The note ties the delivery and payment details to this written order.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one pair of Pilferer's Gloves.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the gloves?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the transaction?
faq.answer: You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
